text: This staff report is regarding a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. In accordance with city-wide residential demolition control under the Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 363, under the authority of Section 33 of the Planning Act, the applications for the demolition of 2-storey, 3-storey and townhouse single-family residential units and associated garages at 63, 65, 67, 71, 73, 75, 77, 79, 81, 81A, 83, 85, 87, 89, 91 Montclair Avenue (Application Nos. 22-225425 DEM 00 DM, 22-225430 DEM 00 DM, 22-225437 DEM 00 DM, 22-225446 DEM 00 DM, 22-225454 DEM 00 DM, 22-225366 DEM 00 DM, 22-225360 DEM 00 DM, 22-225354 DEM 00 DM, 22-225349 DEM 00 DM, 22-225228 DEM 00 DM, 22-225390 DEM 00 DM, 22-225396 DEM 00 DM, 22-225400 DEM 00 DM, 22 225408 DEM 00 DM and 22-225415 DEM 00 DM) in preparation for a new 18 & 19 storey building…
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred consideration of the Item until its April 12, 2023 meeting.
